question.text: A ray of light is incident at an angle of incidence <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>60</mn><mo>°</mo></math> on the glass slab of refractive index <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt></math>. After refraction, the light ray emerges out from other parallel faces and lateral shift between incident ray and emergent ray is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>. The thickness of the glass slab is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>cm</mi></math>.

solution.text:
From snell's law, sinisinr=3⇒sin60°sinr=3⇒r=30°

From the diagram shown, d=tsini-rcosr⇒t×1232=43⇒t=12 cm
